text: Kyocera Corporation (TSE Prime code 6971) lists its top 10 shareholders as of 31 March 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 23.23%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 8.56%), The Bank of Kyoto, Ltd. (4.38%), State Street Bank and Trust Company 505001 (4.10%), the Inamori Foundation (2.84%), Kyocera's own share-investment association (1.75%), JP Morgan Chase Bank 385781 (1.44%), MUFG Bank (1.40%), HSBC Hong Kong (1.31%) and Dai-ichi Life Insurance (1.28%).
short: Kyocera is Tokyo-listed; its largest holders are trust banks (Master Trust 23.23%, Custody Bank 8.56%), the Bank of Kyoto (4.38%) and State Street (4.10%).

source.name: 京セラ: 株式基本情報 (Kyocera Corporation: Basic Stock Information)
